MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The wired earbuds felt relevant because my earlier headset purchase suggests a practical use for wired listening and calls, provided the jack fits my device.",
    "The HDMI cable connected with my history of buying display cables, though that makes it relevant to consider rather than something I need now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming players and Alexa devices do not solve the computer connection or accessory needs reflected in my purchases.",
    "My small-tablet mount served a specific mounting purpose; it does not imply I want another tablet or a wall mount for a television.",
    "The memory card offers storage, but I have no current storage need or confirmed compatible device that would make me choose it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat interest in computer accessories as interest in electronics generally, including streaming and smart-home devices.",
    "They seem to carry interest from an accessory to the device it supports, even though buying a mount does not mean I need a new device."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases are spaced apart and mostly address specific practical needs, so a related product alone gives me little reason to act.",
    "The exact connection and intended use matter: a DVI cable does not establish an HDMI need, and wired earbuds only help if my device supports their jack.",
    "My most recent purchase was a USB-to-Ethernet adapter, which points more directly toward computer connectivity than home entertainment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognized my interest in practical accessories but stretched it into a broad interest in entertainment and Alexa devices."
}
